summary: Power BI Developer Intern (Paid Internship) - Support analytics and reporting initiatives, design dashboards, and analyze data.
responsibilities: Develop Power BI dashboards and interactive visual reports.
Collect and analyze data from various systems and sources.
Create calculated measures using DAX formulas.
Design and optimize data models for reporting purposes.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business reporting requirements.
Ensure data accuracy, performance efficiency, and clean UI design.
Document dashboard structures and deliver clear reports on insights.
required_skills: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields.
Good knowledge of Power BI, including visualization tools, DAX, and data modeling.
Understanding of SQL for data extraction is preferred.
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
Good communication skills to explain insights effectively.
nice_to_have_skills: Understanding of SQL for data extraction
benefits: Hands-on experience with business intelligence projects
